## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #178, exact head `887daaac249143d53d84db29ac96bd65ab371662`.

The complete four-file diff and directly dependent link/close/CAS gates were source-reviewed. No high-confidence new security vulnerability was identified.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new vulnerability identified | - |

The operator command parses correctly: `--parent` must identify the resolved caller, and `--role worker` assigns the child's role, not caller privileges (`crates/daemon/src/http/role.rs:556-649`). Link blocks another untombstoned parent and requires an untombstoned target (`crates/store/src/role_assertion.rs:46-59,254-276`). Thus the note's parent-gone condition means registry-absent/tombstoned, not merely process-dead. Link may adopt living orphans; successful adoption is not proof of the child's death.

Close remains self/recorded-parent-only, rejects force, and never kills the reused pane or process (`crates/daemon/src/http/lifecycle.rs:95-137,344-345,415-432`). A reused pane ID alone justifies neither retirement nor identity attribution. These qualifications apply to the new operator note (`docs/how/pij-rs-api.md:1911`).

The new CAS test updates the descriptor immediately before delegating to the real conditional tombstone transaction and asserts preserved binding plus no tombstone event (`crates/daemon/src/reaper_tests.rs:871-925`; `crates/store/src/registry.rs:61-75`). It exercises the real store guard rather than a mocked refusal, while host observations remain fake.

The golden invariants match the never-bound producer's four brakes (`crates/daemon/src/reaper.rs:118-132`; `crates/testkit/fixtures/golden/api/governance-routes.json:1962-1966`). MANIFEST explicitly labels a text edit, not a fresh runtime capture; the checksum and 89,308-byte size match (`crates/testkit/fixtures/MANIFEST.toml:455-458`).

Added identities are synthetic; no C19/C21 disclosure, private path or credential was identified. GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42445836038` and Delivers run `42445836223` both identify this SHA and success.

No local tests, builds, runtime link/close/tmux operations, credential reads or mutations were performed.
